# Support

## Before anything else

Read [`PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`](../PROJECT_CONTEXT.md). It is short, it is binding, and it answers most
"why is it like this?" questions.

## Where to go

| Need | Where |
|---|---|
| **A security vulnerability** | [Private disclosure](https://github.com/scigns/witness/security/advisories/new) — **never** a public issue. See [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) |
| Something is broken | [Bug report](https://github.com/scigns/witness/issues/new?template=bug.yml) |
| The documentation failed me | [Documentation issue](https://github.com/scigns/witness/issues/new?template=docs.yml) — this is a real defect, not a complaint |
| A question | [Discussions](https://github.com/scigns/witness/discussions) |
| A feature idea | [Feature request](https://github.com/scigns/witness/issues/new?template=feature.yml) |
| A conduct concern | [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |

## What we can and cannot offer

**We can:** answer questions about the software, its architecture and its deployment; fix defects;
improve documentation; discuss whether Witness fits your situation — including telling you when it
does not.

**We cannot:** provide guaranteed response times without a support arrangement; give legal advice
about whether a particular recording is lawful in your jurisdiction; operate your deployment; or
access your data — we hold none of it, by design.

**Commercial support** from third-party vendors is encouraged, and no vendor is privileged by us.
See [`GOVERNANCE.md`](../GOVERNANCE.md).

## Current state

Witness is **pre-implementation** ([`STATUS.md`](../STATUS.md)). There is nothing to install yet.
Questions about architecture, governance and roadmap are very welcome; questions about running it
are premature, and we would rather say so than pretend otherwise.
